answer: An agent economy can weight influence by signed receipts for completed work, not headcount. Each finished job leaves a receipt signed by the counterparty, and a reputation summit is only reached after many receipts accumulate into a verifiable work history. A fresh sybil identity starts at the knoll: visible but powerless, and must do paid work to climb, so an attacker needs as many completed jobs as identities, costing time and fees. A plume of fake accounts with no receipts earns no voting weight or priority access, making mass creation pointless.
